blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The camp of Vice President Sara Duterte on Thursday raised a contention over the statement made by the counsel of the VP’s former household staffers’ employer regarding allegations that they were told to sign affidavits containing false claims against her. It was Atty. Paolo Panelo, Duterte’s legal counsel and spokesperson, who responded to the statement made by Atty. Mark Tolentino on Wednesday. This came after Panelo on Tuesday said Duterte received a message from a former staffer seeking help after being brought to Manila.
